live_state_rechecked.branch_protection: not retrievable: GitHub API returned 401 Unauthorized without credentials

partial_status_note: Repository-local workflow hardening is complete and tested; server-side branch/ruleset enforcement is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_GITHUB_PERMISSION.

remaining_blockers.detail: No GitHub credentials (no gh CLI, no GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN). Branch protection and rulesets are server-side state and cannot be read or written.
exact_action_required: gh auth login  (or export GITHUB_TOKEN with repo:administration scope for a classic PAT)

required_checks_designed: offline release gate (job 'offline release gate') -- satisfies GitHub-hosted CI
runtime certification gate -- NOT required on the branch by default because it needs a self-hosted CARLA runner
title: GitHub enforcement and CI supply-chain hardening

workflow_hardening.concurrency: offline gates cancel stale runs; the runtime certification workflow deliberately does NOT cancel long acceptance runs
workflow_hardening.least_privilege_permissions: contents: read at workflow level and in every job
workflow_hardening.note_on_movable_tags: The v4/v5 major tags were first resolved and rejected as pins because they are mutable; the SHAs above are the immutable release-tag commits, each re-verified to match its tag after selection.
